articles.title: Quem é Milton Leite, ex-presidente da Câmara de SP alvo de operação que investiga infiltração do PCC | G1
articles.standfirst: Ex-vereador ficou 27 anos no Legislativo paulistano, presidiu a Câmara quatro vezes e cumpriu o último mandato em 2024, mas continuou atuando na política partidária.
articles.summary: Ex-vereador ficou 27 anos no Legislativo paulistano, presidiu a Câmara quatro vezes e cumpriu o último mandato em 2024, mas continuou atuando na política partidária.
articles.body:
O ex-vereador Milton Leite (União Brasil) recebe, em junho de 2025, o Colar de Honra ao Mérito Legislativo, a maior honraria da Alesp — Foto: Divulgação/Alesp

Milton Leite, do União Brasil, é um dos políticos mais tradicionais — e poderosos — de São Paulo. Ocupou uma cadeira na Câmara Municipal da capital por 27 anos, entre 1997 e 2024, e presidiu o Legislativo paulistano por quatro vezes .

Com 70 anos, ele começou na política em 1990. Quando jovem, chegou a ser filiado ao PCB, mas pouco depois ingressou no MDB. Ao longo da carreira, construiu sua principal base eleitoral na Zona Sul da capital, especialmente no Grajaú.

Nas eleições de 2020, foi o segundo vereador mais votado da cidade, com 132.716 votos . Naquele ano, sua campanha foi a que mais gastou entre os candidatos à Câmara, com despesas de cerca de R$ 2,5 milhões. Segundo o site da Câmara, ele já ocupou o cargo de prefeito em exercício da capital por cerca de cem dias, tornando-se o presidente da Câmara que mais vezes chefiou o Executivo desde a redemocratização.

Leite também acumulou influência dentro do Legislativo paulistano. Foi presidente da Câmara pela primeira vez entre 2017 e 2019, durante a gestão de João Doria na prefeitura, e voltou ao comando da Casa por três mandatos consecutivos. Em dezembro de 2022, foi novamente eleito para a presidência, com 47 dos 55 votos dos vereadores.

Naquele período, uma mudança na Lei Orgânica do Município permitiu uma segunda reeleição para a presidência da Câmara. A eleição também contou com um acordo de representação entre as bancadas, que garantiu espaço para PT, PL e Republicanos na Mesa Diretora.

Ao anunciar que não disputaria uma nova vaga de vereador em 2024, Leite afirmou que aquele seria seu último mandato parlamentar e que deixaria a vida pública. Em agosto daquele ano, não registrou candidatura à Câmara pela primeira vez após 27 anos no Legislativo. Disse que pretendia continuar como militante do partido por algum tempo antes de se dedicar ao setor privado.

Ao anunciar a aposentadoria política, disse que pretendia “ir pescar, cuidar da saúde, da família e dos negócios”.

Apesar de deixar a vereança, Leite continuou com atuação política nos bastidores. Em dezembro de 2024, indicou o então secretário de Mobilidade e Trânsito Ricardo Teixeira como seu sucessor na presidência da Câmara . Teixeira foi eleito para comandar a Casa em janeiro de 2025.

Leite também passou a presidir o diretório estadual do União Brasil. Em junho de 2025, foi homenageado na Assembleia Legislativa de São Paulo com o Colar de Honra ao Mérito Legislativo, maior honraria concedida pela Casa .

O evento reuniu políticos de diferentes partidos e, segundo o relato publicado à época, aliados viam a homenagem como uma forma de estimular sua volta à política.

Leite tem ainda dois filhos na política: o deputado estadual Milton Leite Filho (União Brasil) e o deputado federal Alexandre Leite (União Brasil).

Em dezembro de 2024, já fora da Câmara, Milton Leite indicou o vereador Ricardo Teixeira, do União Brasil, para disputar a presidência da Casa. Teixeira acabou eleito para o cargo em 1º de janeiro de 2025.

Fora do Legislativo, Leite tem vínculos com as empresas de ônibus da cidade e com a Liga das Escolas de Samba de São Paulo.

É presidente de honra da escola de samba Estrela do Terceiro Milênio, do Grajaú, agremiação da qual ele e os filhos são patronos. A escola chegou ao Grupo Especial do carnaval paulistano em 2023, após vencer o Grupo de Acesso em 2022.

articles.title: Watch: Lionel Messi wins 49th career trophy with 100th goal for Inter Miami
articles.summary: Football News: Lionel Messi marked another major milestone on Wednesday, scoring his 100th goal for Inter Miami as the MLS club beat Mexican side Cruz Azul 2-0 to wi.
articles.body: Lionel Messi marked another major milestone on Wednesday, scoring his 100th goal for Inter Miami as the MLS club beat Mexican side Cruz Azul 2-0 to win the Campeones Cup in Florida.Messi opened the scoring in the 24th minute, heading home a pinpoint cross from Luis Suárez. Casemiro then sealed the victory with a late header as Miami lifted another trophy.The goal came in Messi’s 115th appearance for the club, making him the fastest player to score 100 goals for any club or country. He had previously reached the milestone in 188 games for Barcelona and 174 appearances for Argentina.Messi delivers another trophy for MiamiSince joining Inter Miami in 2023, Messi has scored 76 goals in MLS, 14 in the Leagues Cup, eight in the Concacaf Champions Cup and one at the FIFA Club World Cup.The victory also gave new Miami coach Cristian “Kily” González a trophy in his first game in charge.Watch:“Leo [Messi] told me I was going to become a champion, and he made it happen," González said, as per ESPN."Moving forward, this gives us a huge morale boost, it's a vital element for us, and while we've achieved this, we have to keep going," he added.Messi, who is 39, joined Miami after spells with Barcelona and Paris Saint-Germain. He has now helped the club win four trophies.The Campeones Cup was also the 49th trophy of Messi’s career.Messi set for Argentina farewellMessi is also preparing for his final appearance for Argentina. The eight-time Ballon d’Or winner announced last month that he would retire from international football.Argentina will play Benin in Buenos Aires on October 6, with the match expected to serve as Messi’s farewell.“We invited ⁠the world’s best player, our national-team icon, our captain Lionel Andres Messi, to have a deserved farewell here in Argentina,” AFA president Claudio Tapia wrote on social media."Lionel Messi, Rodrigo De Paul, and Giovani Lo Celso will join the squad for the final friendly match on October 6th. The list of players called up from the domestic league will be announced on Friday," the Argentine FA said.Messi has scored 125 goals in 207 appearances for Argentina. His international career includes a World Cup title in 2022 and two Copa America triumphs.“After the time that has passed since the final, and after giving it a lot of thought, I want to let everyone know that I am retiring from the Argentina national team,” wrote Messi on 31 August. “It was a decision that hurt – and still hurts deep down – but I understand that the time has come.“I swear to you that I always gave it my all – not just in these last few years when we won everything, but before that too. I always fought and left everything on the field for this jersey, to bring you joy and make you, through football, feel proud to be Argentinian.”Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Carolina Holguín cierra su etapa como presidenta del Eldense
articles.standfirst: Bajo su liderazgo, el club logró tres ascensos en una misma temporada: el del primer equipo, el del filial y el del equipo femenino
articles.summary: Bajo su liderazgo, el club logró tres ascensos en una misma temporada: el del primer equipo, el del filial y el del equipo femenino
articles.body: Punto final a la etapa de Carolina Holguín como presidenta del Eldense tras hacerse oficial el pasado martes el traspaso de propiedad a manos de Leo Messi. Su etapa al frente del club ha durado menos de un año. En un comunicado, se resalta la consecución de tres ascensos (el del primer equipo a LaLiga Hypermotion, el del filial a Tercera RFEF y también el del equipo femenino). La ya expresidenta expresa que ha sido "un trayecto nada sencillo, con decisiones difíciles, complejas y en ocasiones impopulares". No falta el agradecimiento a futbolistas, cuerpo técnico y afición. Tampoco dejó pasar la ocasión para agradecer al Ayuntamiento de Elda, con el que se trabajó mano a mano, y el apoyo institucional ofrecido por el consistorio. En el extenso comunicado, tampoco dejó de lado a sus detractores, los que reforzaron su autoestima. Acabó ensalzando a las mujeres de Elda, así como a los niños.

articles.title: Mensaje a Maroan: Terzic decide si es una apuesta circunstancial o sólida
articles.standfirst: El delantero iba a jugar ante el Levante y ahora el técnico tomará postura frente al Alavés
articles.summary: El delantero iba a jugar ante el Levante y ahora el técnico tomará postura frente al Alavés
articles.body: El Athletic ha regresado de Valencia esta mañana de jueves para realizar una sesión de entrenamiento en Lezama. La misma será más intensa de lo que estaba planificado pues los esfuerzos del partido ante el Levante quedaron en nada tras la suspensión del mismo por condiciones meteorológicas adversas. Los dos clubes trabajan ya en ofrecer una propuesta de fecha a la Liga, que acogerá sin titubeos que ésta se dilucide en una semana de competición europea. La prevista alineación de Terzic en el Ciutat de Valencia incluyó por vez primera como titular en la punta de ataque a Maroan, que el fin de semana había tenido minutos en el intento de remontada ante el Elche. El delantero no pudo dar la razón a su entrenador porque no hubo minutos. Y ahora es cosa de Terzic demostrar que era una apuesta real o se ceñía a la necesidad de rotar por jugar tres partidos en una semana. El preparador rojiblanco defendió en la entrevista que ofreció antes del no partido a la televisión con derechos que había elegido a Maroan por su rendimiento en los entrenamientos y lo que puede aportar al equipo. El derbi con el Alavés es sólo dos entrenamientos después del viaje a Valencia por lo que se da por hecho que todo lo contado con el equipo ya vistiéndose en el vestuario del Ciutat de Valencia es válido para el encuentro ante el conjunto babazorro. El delantero llegó al Athletic el mercado de invierno de 2025 después de pagar alrededor de 4 millones de euros al Alavés, el club con el que tenía contrato, y compensar con 300.000 euros al Barakaldo, donde jugó cedido la primera parte de la temporada. El Athletic regresó sin incidencia de Valencia, donde en la fase aguda de la tormenta sí estuvo afectado el aeropuerto de Manises. La única puerta de satisfacción que se abrió tras la suspensión el que el presidente Uriarte, que viajó por vez primera esta temporada con la plantilla, tuvo ocasión y tiempo para hablar con los capitanes en un escenario muy diferente al que quedaría para después de un partido. ¿Lo hizo? Ninguna de las partes han dado luz a la respuesta.

articles.title: El Al-Taawon, sancionado por los cánticos en memoria de Diogo Jota
articles.standfirst: El club saudí deberá jugar dos partidos a puerta cerrada y pagar una multa por los cánticos de sus aficionados
articles.summary: El club saudí deberá jugar dos partidos a puerta cerrada y pagar una multa por los cánticos de sus aficionados
articles.body: El Al-Taawon ha sido castigado por la Federación Saudí de Fútbol después de que circularan en redes sociales imágenes de aficionados del club entonando cánticos en memoria del fallecido delantero portugués Diogo Jota. El organismo consideró que las frases y lemas coreados durante el encuentro infringían su código ético y decidió imponer una multa de 100.000 riales saudíes, unos 23.250 euros, además de ordenar que el equipo dispute sus dos próximos partidos como local a puerta cerrada. La federación también comunicó que la decisión es inapelable. El incidente tuvo especial repercusión después de que aparecieran imágenes en las que Ruben Neves, internacional portugués y jugador del Al-Hilal, parecía reaccionar al escuchar cánticos con el nombre de su antiguo compañero de selección. Jota, futbolista del Liverpool, falleció junto a su hermano André Silva en un accidente de tráfico ocurrido en España en julio de 2025. El delantero del Al-Nassr pidió que los aficionados responsables "fueran expulsados de por vida de los estadios". En un mensaje publicado en Instagram, Ronaldo defendió la necesidad de que la competición "actuara ante comportamientos que, en su opinión, traspasan los límites del fútbol" y reclamó "medidas contundentes" contra quienes participaron en los cánticos. En medio de la polémica, los aficionados del Al-Hilal mostraron posteriormente su apoyo a Neves durante el partido frente al Al-Gharafa. La grada formó un enorme número ocho, correspondiente al dorsal del centrocampista portugués, acompañado de una pancarta con el mensaje: “Juntos más allá del fútbol”. El gesto sirvió como muestra de solidaridad hacia Rubén Neves y como recuerdo de Jota, cuya muerte continúa generando muestras de apoyo entre compañeros, aficionados y figuras del fútbol portugués.

articles.title: Ángel Baena: "El Oviedo es un muy buen equipo, pero nosotros también"
articles.standfirst: El nuevo 10 arlequinado ha admitido que Ferran Costa ha sido clave para su fichaje
articles.summary: El nuevo 10 arlequinado ha admitido que Ferran Costa ha sido clave para su fichaje
articles.body: Ferran Costa ha insuflado autoestima e ilusión a la Nova Creu Alta y al Sabadell, 11º clasificado de LaLiga Hypermotion con un balance notable de 8/15 puntos en su regreso a la categoría tras un doble ascenso consecutivo. La ciudad vive el mejor momento de su historia reciente y afronta el presente y el futuro sin miedo. Se ha vuelto a evidenciar este jueves, en la puesta de largo de Ángel Baena, uno de los últimos fichajes. "El Oviedo es un muy buen equipo, pero nosotros también. Ellos también estarán pensando en nosotros. En que vienen a un campo muy complicado, con una afición que aprieta y un rival al que le gusta luchar y competir", ha subrayado el nuevo 10 del equipo arlequinado, en una declaración de intenciones hacia el siguiente rival. El extremo catalán también ha reconocido que Costa, el entrenador, ha sido determinante para su llegada a la Nova Creu Alta, procedente del Widzew Lodz polaco. "Al empezar el verano tenía claro que me iba a quedar en Polonia porque tenía contrato en vigor. Fueron pasando las semanas y surgió alguna opción en España. Hablé con Ferran porque ya nos conocíamos y me convenció para venir aquí", ha explicado. Ya habían coincidido como jugador y entrenador en la Damm, en su etapa cadete. Costa ya había dicho que Baena era un jugador ideal para el Sabadell y le ha dado su confianza desde el primer día: se estrenó con más de media hora en la victoria épica contra el Córdoba (3-2) y ya fue titular en la derrota contra el Mallorca (2-0), la primera de la temporada para los arlequinados. El Sabadell cayó víctima de dos "errores puntuales", pero Baena ha insistido en que el equipo debe seguir en la misma línea. "Hemos empezado muy bien el año y la clave es seguir igual", ha recalcado. También ha asegurado que tenía "muchas ganas de volver a casa", tras tantos años lejos del fútbol catalán. Después de destacar en la Damm, pasó por el filial del Betis y el Lugo y en 2023 ya emigró a Polonia. Primero sumó 6 goles y 14 asistencias con la camiseta del histórico Wisla de Cracovia, con el que se proclamó campeón de copa desde la categoría de plata, y después, 3 goles y 5 asistencias con el Widzew Lodz. Ahora ha vuelto a casa de la mano del Sabadell y de su mentor.

articles.title: Sunderland AFC, It Was Always You
articles.summary: After a night that will live forever in Sunderland’s history, one supporter reflects on the emotions, memories and magic of finally seeing the Lads back in E...
articles.body:
I slipped a note underneath the pillow of my seven-year-old, letting her know the score when she woke up in the morning. Just to make sure she understood, I added below: "We Won!"

I went back downstairs into the living room.

There, I sat quietly for a minute or two.

The noise had come like a wave, but now silence reigned supreme.

The big occasions do this to us; every fan can recall returning from the Stadium of Light, assaulted by the barrage on the senses of sights, sounds and smells. Emotions overtake your body, and you need a moment of calm to allow your internal checks and balances to regain control.

You may have been watching from afar, and the ability to be present at an occasion like last night was not possible; yet no doubt you too will have given yourself time to recover – whether you are in your front room in Australia, America, Europe or another far-flung part of the world.

Because the allegiance runs deep in all of our veins, and that is why we showed the world who we are: Sunderland AFC . A football world that turned its back on this institution when it was in the depths of despair. There is no interest in a club on its knees, hoist by its own petard on the back of a litany of disastrous decisions. And in truth, we didn't want anyone to look, we didn't want you to see us like this.

Wednesday, September 16th 2026 was a moment for inward reflection. To store up these memories and emotions to access in years to come. It wasn't actually to focus on what others outside of our Wearside world thought.

Words penned by someone else can't sum up another's emotions, which are so personal to them. There is no point in trying. But you know what they mean to you. They are yours. Some you share with loved ones and friends, others you keep to yourself. But this experience is now part of our collective history as supporters.

And just like the generation of 1973, we are all now the lucky ones.

Whatever path this club now follows, this is a moment set in stone. It cannot be removed, erased, airbrushed or glossed over.

Too often we live for what might come in the future, but for one glorious evening on the banks of the Wear, we lived in the present. A moment none of us wanted to end.

During our time in League One, nobody would have predicted that an autumn night in the not-too-distant future would show us all what the essence of being a football supporter was: a night as pure as the driven snow.

And what of my little girl? Will she too one day put a note under her child's pillow, letting her know the score of some game to be played in the long-distant future? Maybe. Maybe not.

But when she grows up, if she's lucky enough to experience a night like this, then all those pieces of paper will have been worth it.

Sunderland AFC, I have fallen in love with you. But then again, it was always you.

articles.title: Kyle Walker: Burnley defender 'desperate' to end winless run with Derby County up next
articles.summary: Burnley defender Kyle Walker says he has "never wanted a victory as much" as against Derby County on Saturday, as Clarets aim to turn around their sorry start to the season.
articles.body:
Burnley defender Kyle Walker said he has "never wanted a victory as much" as against Derby County on Saturday, as Clarets aim to turn around their sorry start to the season.

Bottom of the Championship and without a victory inside 90 minutes this term , Burnley's winless run stretches back to 11 February and 22 games - including a run of 13 games at the tail end of a 2025-26 campaign where they were relegated from the Premier League.

Walker, who won 17 trophies with Manchester City prior to his move to Turf Moor in July 2025 and was part of City's Treble-winning squad in 2023, has played in six Championship games so far this term.

"I'm desperate," he told BBC Radio Lancashire. "I've never wanted a victory so much because there's a lot of noise.

"Am I the most talented player? Definitely not. I played with many more talented players than me but what I pride myself on is working hard and proving people wrong.

"That's what hopefully I can prove by coming out and being the voice of the of the players and hopefully they're listening to this and they take this on board that I'm not laying down and I'm willing to fight for the all the way to the very end."

From best to worst: The case for Burnley's defence

'It's not a blip, Burnley are in crisis'

Prior to joining Burnley, Walker had been regarded as one of the best right-backs in world football and had enjoyed an enormous amount of success at Manchester City under the stewardship of Pep Guardiola.

The relationship between Walker and Guardiola broke down , leading to him spending time on loan with Italian giants AC Milan, but the England international returned to England with Burnley ahead of what had been their return to the Premier League last year.

Asked about how the difference between winning regularly with City to the contrast of the past 14 months with Burnley, Walker said it had been a tough transition.

"I've probably not experienced this ever. It's a different dressing room to what I was in at City where everyone kind of marshalled themselves," he added

"You didn't have to really rile people up to get them a game of football out of them. They had their own standards and they set their own bars to then go and achieve certain things.

"I think that's why they're at Manchester City and why Manchester City were so successful because we had a great manager.

"I think even if Pep wasn't there we would have gone on and achieved a lot of things as well because we had a great team and a great togetherness within that.

"I'm not saying that the togetherness is not within Burnley because it completely is, it's a great bunch of lads."

Pre-match, post-match and topical Clarets content

Saturday's fixture against Derby (15:00 BST) is the final game before the new, extended September and October international break and will be the last match they play for three weeks.

Walker is torn on how to view the break, whether it provides an opportunity to push on in October should they win at the weekend or if it is a welcome period of respite after a tough start to the campaign.

"I think you can look at it in two ways. You win on Saturday and you want to keep going then, don't you?" he said.

"You're losing, you're kind of thinking, thank God the international break's coming, you can kind of go back to the drawing board and start again.

"It's a bit weird for me because I've never experienced this in my career where I'm saying that I want this international break to come, good or bad.

"But it's the position that we're in and we're not here to beat around the bush, we're here to talk face to face and man up on it and we need a win, that's the be all and end all of it."

articles.title: Jakirovic on team news, expectations and international break
articles.summary: Hull City boss Sergej Jakirovic has been speaking to the media before Saturday's Premier League game against Newcastle at St James' Park (kick-off 15:00 BST)...
articles.body:
Hull City boss Sergej Jakirovic has been speaking to the media before Saturday's Premier League game against Newcastle at St James' Park (kick-off 15:00 BST).

Here are the key lines from his news conference:

Nobel Mendy will not feature because of concussion protocols, but "everything is fine" and he is "good". Matt Targett is a doubt after twisting his ankle. Hidemasa Morita is still out and Jakirovic said the "plan is he will join us after the first week of the international break". The Tigers boss said they are being "cautious" with Charlie Hughes but hopes he can join group training within the next two weeks.

On the extended international break, the Hull boss said: "We have a lot of international players which we are very proud of that but from the other side it will be very busy for them." He said the club have organised a friendly against Sheffield United on 1 October.

He was also asked about Oli McBurnie 's recall to the Scotland squad and said: "I'm proud, he is already proud because you represent your country and this is the highest level of football and [I] just hope Oli and all the rest of the players come [back] healthy."

The Tigers boss says his side have shown they "can compete at this level", even against Chelsea at Stamford Bridge, which he says was a "very difficult game". He added: "I said I'm happy with one point even a lot of people told me that maybe we should [have] won this game but I want to be grateful because every point in every game, especially in these demanding away games, it's good for us. We will try to still be unbeaten but I'm expecting a very tough game especially after Newcastle's defeat at Leeds ."

Jakirovic was asked whether he is enjoying "silencing the doubters" after their start to the season: "[There] will be always some doubters. We know our way, we know our style and we will try like always to improve some things... we will see after the end of this season. I hope we can continue like this."

On keeping his players' feet on the ground, he added: "In every meeting we are speaking about expectation, about that we must stay on the ground, that we know our goal - to stay in the league no matter how many points we have because this season is a long season."

articles.summary: Belichick had been on medical leave since early August.
articles.body:
Steve Belichick is out as North Carolina's defensive coordinator after reportedly resigning on Thursday, according to ESPN's Pete Thamel .

Belichick has been on medical leave since early August.

"We look forward to getting him back as soon as possible," Tar Heels head coach Bill Belichick said at the time. "It's a medical situation, so I really can't make any further comment."

articles.title: El Levante plantea una reflexión sobre "la idoneidad de los horarios" y "los protocolos vigentes en días con alertas meteorológicas"
articles.standfirst: El club anuncia que su consejero delegado, José Danvila, prepara una carta al presidente de LaLiga, Javier Tebas, para tratar posibles modificaciones en las actuaciones
articles.summary: El club anuncia que su consejero delegado, José Danvila, prepara una carta al presidente de LaLiga, Javier Tebas, para tratar posibles modificaciones en las actuaciones
articles.body: El Levante ha emitido un comunicado en el que solicita a LaLiga modificaciones en los protocolos de actuación de la competición en situaciones de alerta meteorológica como la que obligó a suspender el Levante-Athletic de ayer en el Ciutat de València. El club anuncia que su consejero delegado, prepara una carta al presidente de LaLiga, Javier Tebas, para tratar posibles modificaciones en las actuaciones e informa que el partido no supondrá la pérdida de bonificaciones que sus socios tienen por asistencia a los partidos y habilita un proceso de devolución de entradas. El Levante UD agradece el comportamiento de la afición tras la suspensión por tormenta del encuentro ante el Athletic Club y solicita a LALIGA una revisión de los protocolos y horarios por alerta meteorológica. El club garantiza que el partido no penalizará la fidelidad de ningún abonado y habilita el proceso de devolución de entradas. El Levante UD desea agradecer de manera sincera a toda su afición el ejemplar comportamiento, el civismo y la serenidad demostrados durante la noche de ayer. En un contexto sumamente complejo, donde acudíamos a disputar un partido de fútbol previniendo la lluvia y nos encontramos con una tormenta torrencial, la actitud de nuestro público fue intachable. Ante la gravedad de los acontecimientos, el consejero delegado del Levante UD, José Danvila, prepara una carta al presidente de LALIGA, Javier Tebas. En ella, el club exige una reflexión profunda sobre la idoneidad de los horarios fijados y sobre los protocolos vigentes en días con alertas meteorológicas decretadas por organismos oficiales. Asimismo, se ha solicitado revisar los criterios de suspensión de encuentros, dado que nuestra afición no pudo conocer la cancelación del choque hasta la hora de inicio del mismo. Estas situaciones deben ayudarnos a aprender y mejorar. Afortunadamente, tal y como consta en las primeras valoraciones, todo el personal del club actuó con absoluta efectividad. Los servicios de seguridad mantuvieron a los asistentes resguardados en las zonas cubiertas bajo la grada hasta que la intensidad del agua permitió iniciar una evacuación ordenada y segura. La entidad transmite su reconocimiento tanto a la afición como a los empleados por su predisposición y colaboración en todo momento. Gestión de asistencia y entradas Aunque la cifra oficial registrada fue de más de 9.000 espectadores, la intensidad de la tormenta motivó la apertura de tornos para permitir el rápido acceso de las personas a las zonas cubiertas. El club es consciente de que la cifra real fue superior. Este encuentro suspendido no penalizará a ningún abonado en el cómputo final de asistencia y fidelización, haya acudido o no al estadio. A efectos de gestión, computará exactamente igual que si el abonado hubiera liberado su asiento. De igual modo, para la fecha del nuevo encuentro, que podría producirse el 21 de octubre, aquel abonado que no pueda asistir podrá liberar su asiento sin sufrir tampoco penalización alguna. Devolución de entradas: Compra online: El reembolso se tramitará de forma automática en el mismo método de pago utilizado, haciendo efectivo el abono en un plazo de 2 a 10 días hábiles a contar desde hoy. NO hace falta enviar ningún correo ni hacer ninguna acción. Se reembolsará de forma automática. Compra en taquilla: Los compradores deberán acudir presencialmente con sus entradas o bien remitir un correo electrónico a ticketing@levanteud.es. En este mensaje deberán adjuntar la entrada, el comprobante de pago con tarjeta (o indicar los últimos cuatro dígitos de la tarjeta empleada) o indicar si la compra se realizó en efectivo, caso en el que se les indicará el procedimiento de devolución. El Levante UD quiere trasladar un agradecimiento muy especial al Athletic Club y a toda su afición desplazada desde Bilbao por su impecable comportamiento y comprensión ante la situación vivida en Orriols. Anoche, en un escenario sumamente adverso, volvimos a demostrar la fuerza de estar unidos. Ayudándonos unos a otros y comportándonos como la gran familia que somos, pusimos de manifiesto los valores que nos definen como club. Agradecemos profundamente las numerosas muestras de apoyo y cariño recibidas a lo largo de las últimas horas.

articles.title: Kevin Miller: Former Exeter City, Crystal Palace and Watford goalkeeper dies aged 57
articles.summary: Former Exeter City, Crystal Palace, Barnsley and Watford goalkeeper Kevin Miller dies aged 57.
articles.body:
Former Exeter City, Crystal Palace, Barnsley and Watford goalkeeper Kevin Miller has died aged 57.

Miller, who had been working as Wigan Athletic‘s goalkeeping coach, passed away unexpectedly overnight on Tuesday.

He moved to the Latics over the summer to re-unite with former Exeter boss Gary Caldwell having stepped down as the Devon side's goalkeeping coach in June.

He also had playing spells at Birmingham City, Bristol Rovers, Southampton, Torquay United and Bodmin Town in his native Cornwall.

"Although Kevin's time with Latics was far too short, he quickly became a much-loved and respected member of our first team staff," Wigan Athletic said in a statement posted on their website. , external

"His experience, professionalism and passion for goalkeeping were clear for all to see, while his uplifting personality made a lasting impression on everyone who had the privilege of working alongside him.

"Kevin's contribution to football was significant, but for those who worked alongside him, it was the person he was that will be remembered most.

"Kevin was a husband, father, hugely respected colleague, dedicated coach and someone who made a genuine impact on those around him, both on and off the pitch.

"His sudden passing has left everyone at the club deeply saddened and devastated.

"Our thoughts and prayers are with Kevin's wife, Fiona, daughter, Esme, close family, friends, colleagues and all who knew and loved him."

Exeter described Miller as having earned "a place in the hearts of supporters with his performances between the posts and his wholehearted commitment to the club".

"As a player, Kevin had a commanding presence and a fierce competitive spirit," his former club added , external in a tribute.

"At just 57, his passing is a huge loss to his family, friends and everyone who knew him.

"Exeter City Football Club sends its deepest condolences to Kevin's family and friends at this incredibly difficult time. Our thoughts are also with Gary Caldwell and our former staff at Wigan Athletic.

"His time in Devon left a lasting impression on those around the club, and his contribution remains a big part of Exeter City's story.

"The club will be supporting those who were close to Kevin and will be commemorating Kevin's time with us and his memory in an appropriate way."

Having come up through the Cornish non-league scene with Newquay and Falmouth Town, he joined Exeter City in 1989, helping the club to the fourth-tier title during a 200-game spell.

He moved to Birmingham City for a season in 1993 and then had three years at Watford, twice winning player of the season, before moving to Premier League Palace in 1997 for a fee of £1.5m.

He played in all 38 games as Palace were relegated from the top flight in 1998 and was first choice in the subsequent Division One campaign as the Eagles finished 14th.

Miller left that summer to begin a three-year spell at Barnsley, before returning to Exeter City in 2002 for a season.

Two years at Bristol Rovers followed before short spells at Southampton and Torquay United, ending his career with 738 appearances in the professional game.

articles.title: The wild story behind Trinidad Chambliss' Ole Miss return starts with Lane Kiffin
articles.summary: Chambliss is thriving in Oxford, and that's due in no small part to his former coach Lane Kiffin, who helped get the QB another year of eligibility. But was...
articles.body:
OXFORD — Tom Mars furiously swipes through his phone.

"I know I kept it," he says. "It's just too funny."

An attorney most famous for his takedowns of the NCAA, Mars retains this specific text message — sent to him last December — for one, big reason. The eight-word text kicked off one of the more gratifying and fascinating legal pursuits of his career: the Mississippi state court case that ended in Ole Miss quarterback Trinidad Chambliss gaining a sixth season of eligibility.

About two weeks after LSU introduced its new head football coach, Lane Kiffin privately and quietly maneuvered to help, of all people, the all-star quarterback of his former school, which just so happens to be his new school's chief rival. He connected Mars with the Chambliss family and the quarterback's agent; they enlisted Mars to assist the university's last-ditch effort to convince the NCAA to grant Chambliss a waiver; and then, when that waiver was denied, they retained him to mount their legal attack against the organization.

The litigious fight culminated in the most bizarre scene from a rural Mississippi courthouse in February: A local judge, growing emotional from reading aloud his own verdict, granted Chambliss an additional year of eligibility by prohibiting the NCAA from enforcing its rules.

Seven months later, here in one of America's most charming college towns, that decision resurfaces as a centerpiece to one of the most anticipated regular season games in the history of the storied Southeastern Conference: LSU vs. Ole Miss.

Among the myriad drama-soaked storylines, there is perhaps one that is most fascinating: LSU's head football coach holds some responsibility in the continued eligibility of Ole Miss' Heisman Trophy-worthy quarterback.

Of course, those here in Oxford say that wasn't Kiffin's original intention.

"His sole motivation was to get him eligible and bring him to Baton Rouge," quipped one person familiar with Kiffin's recruiting efforts last December.

This game drips with intrigue, from Kiffin's pursuit of Chambliss (and other players) to so much else.

More than two dozen coaches and staff members traded places this offseason, moving from LSU to Ole Miss or Ole Miss to LSU. Ole Miss head coach Pete Golding, originally from Louisiana , grew up surrounded by the purple and gold. And Ole Miss is suing two LSU players over buyouts they owe after following their coach to Baton Rouge.

Kiffin's aggressive recruiting effort of Ole Miss players, while they practiced and competed in the College Football Playoff, serves as one of the many screws the coach twisted into his former school.

Relationships here are forever cratered.

Just ask Walker Jones, the former agent and apparel executive who Kiffin hired five years ago to operate the school's NIL collective. He grew as close to Kiffin as anyone in Oxford.

In published comments from an interview with Yahoo Sports in January, Jones fired a barb at Kiffin that caught the coach's attention enough to trigger a private text exchange.

"Unfortunately, the more things change, the more they stay the same," Jones said then. "He's been a chaser and always will be."

In interviews this week, a few days ahead of Saturday's prime-time collision, Jones, athletic director Keith Carter and others intentionally avoid Kiffin talk. The consensus is clear: This fire is already raging; it doesn't need more fuel.

That said, Carter quips about the game, "There may be a little bit more to this one."

And yet, was he, of all people, behind the extended eligibility of Chambliss?

Not completely, those here contend. He was one of many who worked behind the scenes.

But this is true: Some 16 days after being introduced as LSU's coach — at 4:15 p.m. ET on Dec. 17 — Kiffin fired off that text to an attorney he'd never met or spoken with. He even failed — or chose not — to capitalize his first name.

So miffed at the random message, Mars called around to verify the unidentified cell number belonged to the LSU football coach. The two of them then held a conversation.

"He told me about this kid and how great he was," Mars recalled. "He said the waiver had been denied and it'd been going on for a long time and he wanted to get him to LSU and would I be willing to help him? We had a couple of conversations. I wanted Trinidad to have as many opportunities as he could have."

Kiffin connected Mars with the Chambliss family and his agent, Fletcher Smith.

But even before that, the legal process was well underway from the university side through William Liston, a notable Mississippi trial lawyer based in Jackson who serves as general counsel for the Ole Miss collective. Mars teamed up with Liston, plus Oxford attorney Trey Byars, to develop one of the most high-profile eligibility lawsuits in NCAA history — a legal filing that featured a sort-of first-of-its-kind argument.

Weeks before attorneys filed into a rural Mississippi courthouse to deliver their arguments, well before the judge granted Chambliss that injunction, another decision needed to be made.

If Chambliss won his lawsuit, would he play at Ole Miss or LSU?

"It was a hard time," Carter said. "We felt like there was a pull from Baton Rouge for Trinidad."

All of this unfolded during college football's wacky December-January time period — a condensed stretch that includes playoff games, coaching moves and player transfers (the portal was open Jan. 2-16).

After Ole Miss stunned Georgia in a quarterfinal game in New Orleans on Jan. 1, negotiations picked up. A decision needed to be made. Time was running out. How long would LSU even hold a spot for the quarterback not knowing if he'd be eligible? Mars says that answer was around Jan. 2-4, the first weekend in which the portal was open.

"It was a difficult decision," said Smith, Chambliss' agent. "Trinidad loves Ole Miss, but this was his career. We had to look beyond the emotion and ask, 'From a football standpoint, where does he have the best opportunity to succeed?

"But there was a bigger picture," he continued. "Here was a Division II national champion who had defied the odds, stepped into the SEC and succeeded at the highest level. He had earned the respect of people in Oxford and across the country. So you had to ask: Do you walk away from everything you've built and potentially risk being vilified for leaving Ole Miss to go to LSU?"

Smith says the answer eventually "became clear."

For Ole Miss officials, it never felt like the quarterback would leave, said Jones. "But we knew the reality — that people were talking to him."

The coach told those close to him that he needed an answer from Chambliss by the end of that weekend at the latest.

On that Sunday, Jan. 4, three days after Ole Miss' quarterfinal upset of Georgia and four days before the Rebels met Miami in the semifinal, Chambliss made his decision: He struck a deal in a "matter of hours" with the Rebels, Jones says.

The legal situation then hit its stride.

Chambliss needed to gain his eligibility after an NCAA committee — made up of school administrators — denied his waiver. He sought a sixth year of eligibility for a missed season due to a severe case of tonsillitis.

Mars and the team of attorneys were confident in their lawsuit.

First, attorneys used the NCAA's contract with its member universities against the association itself. They claimed that the NCAA denying Chambliss' waiver breached the contract with Ole Miss, and Chambliss, as a third-party beneficiary to that contract, was entitled to damages.

Secondly, Mars alerted attorneys to what he calls a little-known fact: According to the Supreme Court, unincorporated associations like the NCAA hold "citizenship" in each state where their members reside. That means the organization's citizenship in Mississippi prevented a removal of the case from state to federal court, where it would theoretically hold better odds at victory.

Mars doesn't want too much of the credit. He points to Liston and Byars as spearheading the legal argument and the court proceedings and he especially noted the work of Taylor Hall, Ole Miss' ace compliance administrator who led the team from the university side.

"I can't overstate enough how good those two Mississippi trial lawyers are," he said.

On Feb. 12, the Chambliss injunction hearing unfolded within a county courthouse in Pittsboro , Mississippi — population 157. Mars arrived in true southern style: He climbed out of a pickup truck driven by Byars.

He scanned the scene around him. The courthouse represented the lone modern building in the vicinity. A dilapidated shack sat across the black asphalt street, its wooden porch sunken from the weight of dozens of rusting appliances. The town's 174-year-old post office was nearby too, no bigger than a small shuttle bus, its white exterior and 19th-century architecture an image of yesteryear.

"The next nearest restaurant was a barbecue joint that doubles as a tanning salon," Mars said with a laugh.

As the court proceeding began, he witnessed a first in his 40-year career as an attorney: A local pastor, standing in the middle of the court room, delivered a prayer. The pastor ended the benediction by asking the Lord for a favor: Please extend the eligibility of Trinidad Chambliss.

"At that moment, I thought, 'Somebody pinch me!'" Mars said.

Three weeks later, the attorney opened his front door to an elaborate gift box. Awaiting him inside was a note and an autographed jersey from Ole Miss' quarterback.

"It's really funny," he said, "that Lane sets this in motion."

articles.title: Abde entra en el 'club de los 100'
articles.standfirst: El argelino se convirtió el martes en el sexto jugador centenario de la actual plantilla.
articles.summary: El argelino se convirtió el martes en el sexto jugador centenario de la actual plantilla.
articles.body: A Abde Rebbach nadie le ha regalado nada para llegar a la élite. El futbolista argelino aterrizó en la estructura del Alavés con 20 años para recalar en el filial tras realizar todo el recorrido en las categorías inferiores en el Aurrera de Vitoria y el San Ignacio. En el segundo equipo babazorro fue un jugador clave en el ascenso a Segunda RFEF, destapándose como goleador con 16 dianas que le permitieron hacerse un sitio con Luis García Plaza. Dos años tardó en debutar con el primer equipo. Lo hizo en la temporada del ascenso a Primera, en la que disputó 23 partidos. García Plaza le dio continuidad el curso siguiente, aunque no terminó de hacerse un sitio fijo y el Alavés acabó cediéndole en el mercado invernal del siguiente curso al Granada, donde estuvo a un gran nivel (3 goles en 19 partidos). Ni siquiera su excelente rendimiento en Los Cármenes le aseguraba una plaza con Coudet la pasada temporada, pero acabó convenciendo y la llegada de Quique en marzo terminó por consolidarle. Rebbach disputó el pasado martes su encuentro 100 con la camiseta del ‘Glorioso’. El extremo se convierte en uno de los seis integrantes de la actual plantilla que es centenario. Sivera, con 183 participaciones, lidera una lista en la que también figuran Tenaglia (162), Blanco (137), Protesoni (107), Guevera (107) y desde esta semana el futbolista argelino. El ‘21’ se ha convertido en una pieza fundamental en este Alavés desde la llegada de Quique, que le ha situado como carrilero izquierdo casi siempre e incluso partidos como el del martes, con un 4-4-2, no ha tenido reparos en colocarle como lateral. Su verticalidad y velocidad le convierten en un jugador muy del agrado del técnico madrileño, que también le exige en el plano defensivo, donde su crecimiento es una realidad. Abde encadena 12 encuentros consecutivos formando parte del once inicial de Quique y su extraordinario final de curso estuvo a punto de llevarle al Mundial, ya que formó parte de la prelista de Argelia. A sus 28 años disfruta del mejor momento de su carrera tras vivir un recorrido en el que ha tenido que sortear todo tipo de obstáculos hasta llegar a la élite. Un tipo trabajador, que no negocia ningún esfuerzo y que representa como pocos los valores de este Alavés.

articles.title: Authorities Ban PSG Fans from Traveling to Marseille for Sunday's 'Le Classique'
articles.summary: PARIS (AP) — Paris Saint-Germain fans have been banned from traveling to Marseille due to the risk of violent clashes between supporters in connection with the biggest match in French soccer on Sunday, local authorities said.
articles.body:
PARIS (AP) — Paris Saint-Germain fans have been banned from traveling to Marseille due to the risk of violent clashes between supporters in connection with the biggest match in French soccer on Sunday, local authorities said.

The hardcore "ultra" fans of Paris Saint-Germain said they have launched a legal action to challenge the decision ahead of the Ligue 1 match at the Velodrome stadium.

"We are asking our lawyer to bring an emergency procedure before the Council of State in order to contest the upcoming ministerial ban," the Collectif Ultras Paris said. "Since 2015, six prefects have succeeded one another, without any real dialogue ever being established with us. Eleven years of repeated bans cannot take the place of dialogue."

In France, traveling fans are regularly banned from high-risk games and the PSG supporters' legal action is unlikely to succeed.

Justifying the travel ban, France's Interior ministry insisted that relations between Marseille and PSG fans have been hostile for many years. It recalled incidents in Paris in February 2018, during the most recent match attended by supporters of both teams, when eight law enforcement officers were injured.

The match between PSG and Marseille is known as "Le Classique." The confrontation became popular during the 1990s when the arrival of prominent players for both clubs ignited the rivalry. Marseille, the first French team to win the Champions League back in 1993, has fallen well behind since PSG was taken over by Qatari investors in 2011, but the game continues to stir up passion.

Defending champion PSG is two points above Marseille, which has been struggling after failing to recruit any new player over the summer due to financial constraints.

articles.title: Are Hibs set up to follow Motherwell & Hearts coaching model?
articles.summary: After David Gray's departure, what direction might Hibernian go now when it comes to identifying a replacement?
articles.body:
Amid the Hibernian fans' sorrow at the departure of the man they call Sir David Gray, the discussions were already being had. Who - or what - next?

Given the Easter Road club's underwhelming start to the season, and the feeling the writing had been on the wall for the club legend, it would not be a stretch to think that the Hibs board have something of a plan in place.

John Potter will take charge of Saturday's Scottish Premiership home match against Aberdeen, before a lengthy international break.

But who will be in charge when Hibs next take the field at Dundee United on 10 October?

Do sporting director Malky Mackay, chairman Ian Gordon and chief executive Dan Barnett opt for a known name on these shores? Or do they follow city rivals Hearts, and before them Motherwell, in moving for a man abroad?

That appears to be the appetite of the Easter Road faithful. But, whoever they appoint, former Hibs midfielder Scott Allan insists it "has to be right".

Gray sacked by Hibs after six league games

Painful endgame for Gray as stale Hibs slump

Dismissing a manager is nothing new in Hibs' relatively recent past. Not being able to replace them with Gray is, though.

The stints of Jack Ross, Shaun Maloney and Lee Johnson were all followed by Gray taking interim charge. And when Nick Montgomery's tenure ended, Gray again stepped in but stayed for two years.

The Scottish Cup final hero steadied the most unstable of ships, steered them to back-to-back top five finishes and European football in consecutive campaigns.

That was never the issue, though. How they got there, their style of play - or lack thereof recently - was.

That is what makes this next appointment tricky. What is Hibs' ambition?

Motherwell have made it look easy. First, they identified in Jens Berthel Askou, then replaced him - almost seamlessly - with Alfred Johansson after a season of success.

While Askou's side pipped Hibs to fourth on the final day, most in green and white were more worried by what was going on at Celtic Park, where Hearts fell at the final hurdle in their title pursuit. Pure joy and pure relief in Leith.

While there is little doubt Hearts' high-flying campaign counted against Gray, there's a case to be made that the start made by Wouter Vrancken at Tynecastle has been just as detrimental to the departed Hibs manager.

"Naturally when your rivals are going for a league title, pressure comes," Gray's former team-mate Allan told BBC Scotland.

"But how Hearts have transitioned to Vrancken's style, they've been really consistent and look to be going in the right direction.

"With Jamestown, you always knew after Derek McInnes' it'd be that type of manager - and attacking, aggressive style of play - given what they done at Union Saint-Gilloise and Brighton.

"Similiar to Motherwell, their last two decisions have been spot on given how they want to play.

"From a Hibs perspective, they're a bit different. They've kind of looked like they're standing still, with Gray coming under pressure for how the team are performing.

"There has to be accountability upstairs."

Those upstairs also have questions from Cillian Sheridan to answer.

The well-travelled former striker pondered whether Hibs have "the structure" to commit to a route like Motherwell and Hearts.

Speaking on the BBC's Scottish Football Podcast, the Irishman said: "Motherwell have the structure in place to have everything. The manager isn't the main focus, he's a head coach brought in to improve players and play a system.

"I'm not quite sure if Hibs have that structure in place at the minute or if they know what their remit is or style of the club is.

"If you're going down that route, someone else probably needs to be appointed above a manager before that happens.

"It depends what they want. Do they want someone who's just known for winning or being successful? Or do they want someone to come in and develop players with a style of play?

"Are Hibs happy to finish in the same position Gray finished but with football where they might win every second and third game, but they'll win it convincingly and in style? There's are lot of questions."

Big questions which require big answers.

articles.title: Vinicius pierde terreno
articles.standfirst: El brasileño se descuelga en el pulso jerárquico con Mbappé tras la tercera sustitución consecutiva, la última a veinte minutos del final del partido
articles.summary: El brasileño se descuelga en el pulso jerárquico con Mbappé tras la tercera sustitución consecutiva, la última a veinte minutos del final del partido
articles.body: No está siendo un buen comienzo de temporada para Vinicius. "Los goles van a volver, no puedo fallar tanto...", reconocía el jugador tras el partido ante el Elche en un mensaje en sus redes sociales a modo de desahogo. Un problema que en realidad son dos, porque con su rendimiento no se lo está poniendo nada fácil a Mourinho para lidiar con el pulso jerárquico entre el brasileño y Mbappé. El mismo que condenó a sus dos últimos predecesores en el banquillo: Xabi Alonso y Arbeloa. El primero tensó la cuerda por el lado de Vini y el segundo por el de Mbappé. Y en ambos casos se rompieron. Mou llegaba con la difícil misión de tener contentos a los dos. Y eso pasa, en primer lugar, por el cálculo casi milimétrico de sus presencias en el campo. Mourinho empezó midiendo muy bien el protagonismo de ambos sobre el terreno de juego. En los primeros cuatro partidos apenas hubo seis minutos de diferencia en la participación de ambos. Vinicius y Mbappé fueron titulares ante Espanyol, Real Sociedad, Málaga y Betis y sólo el brasileño dejó de jugar seis minutos ante la Real, donde fue sustituido en el 84'. Un cambio 'amable', ya con el partido decidido, con Vinicius firmando un gol y una asistencia y con la intención de Mou de buscar la reconciliación del jugador con el Bernabéu. El 7 no estaba pletórico, pero Mourinho apenas se movió de su 'plan de igualdad' con las dos estrellas. Pero en los tres últimos partidos Vinicius ha perdido terreno. La balanza ya no está tan equilibrada y el brasileño encadena tres sustituciones consecutivas: testimoniales las de Inter (87') y Rayo (89') y a 20 minutos del final frente al Elche (68'). Seis partidos completos de Mbappé y sólo tres de Vinicius; 630' minutos jugados por Mbappé por 598' de Vinicius. Todo ello con el francés desatado tras ocho goles en siete partidos y el brasileño sufriendo con sus estadísticas: un gol y tres asistencias (también provocó un penalti ante el Betis). Siendo titular indiscutible y casi intocable en este inicio de temporada, Vinicius es el quinto máximo goleador del equipo tras Mbappé, Bellingham, Güler y Espí. Este último, en 26 minutos, supera la cifra anotadora del brasileño. El problema no es sólo que Vinicius esté aún lejos de su mejor nivel, sino que Brahim, Espí y ahora Diomande vienen empujando fuerte y no se lo están poniendo fácil a Mourinho para respetar el 'pacto' con Vinicius y Mbappé para no tener problemas con ninguno. Aún queda lejos la situación que provocó el día de furia de Vinicius con Xabi Alonso por culpa de sus constantes sustituciones. La pasada temporada a estas alturas, tras siete partidos, el brasileño ya había sido suplente en dos ocasiones, sólo había completado un partido y había jugado 159 minutos menos. Ahora ha perdido algo de terreno con Mbappé, pero nada traumático que amenace la estabilidad de la relación con Mourinho. Vinicius y Mbappé parecen condenados a 'no entenderse'. Cuando a uno le va bien, al otro le va mal. La conexión entre ambos en su rendimiento parece imposible. Ahora es el francés el que vuela a velocidad de crucero (ocho goles) mientras el brasileño no sale de su atasco (un gol). La pasada temporada, más de lo mismo. La primera parte de la temporada fue traumática para el brasileño, alejado de su mejor nivel (seis goles hasta final de año) y enfrentado a Xabi Alonso, todo ello mientras Mbappé estaba imparable (29 goles hasta final de año). Con Arbeloa cambiaría el escenario: voló Vinicius (16 goles) y frenó Mbappé, motivado también por la lesión de rodilla que condicionó su disponibilidad durante varios partidos. Algo parecido ocurrió en la primera temporada de Mbappé en el Real Madrid con Ancelotti. Al francés le costó arrancar en su temporada de debut como madridista, con su famoso episodio de los dos penaltis fallados consecutivos en Anfield y San Mamés. Mientras, Vinicius tiraba del equipo en un momento en el que parecía que iba directo a la conquista del Balón de Oro. Luego Mbappé reaccionaría hasta alcanzar la espectacular cifra de 44 goles y Vinicius cayó en su rendimiento.

articles.title: Pérez Llorca critica la "imprudencia de LaLiga" por no suspender antes el Levante-Athletic: "Ellos tendrán que explicarlo"
articles.summary: El 'president' de la Generalitat Valenciana, Juanfran Pérez Llorca, ha afirmado que le "parece una imprudencia de LaLiga" el hecho de que no se suspendiese antes, debido a la alerta naranja por lluvias, el partido de fútbol entre el Levante y el Athletic que se iba a disputar en València este miércoles.
articles.body: El 'president' de la Generalitat Valenciana, Juanfran Pérez Llorca, ha afirmado que le "parece una imprudencia de LaLiga" el hecho de que no se suspendiese antes, debido a la alerta naranja por lluvias, el partido de fútbol entre el Levante y el Athletic que se iba a disputar en València este miércoles. "Sus motivos tendrán y ellos tendrán que explicarlo". Así lo ha aseverado Llorca, en una comparecencia este jueves ante los medios desde el puesto de mando de Metrovalencia, preguntado por si cree que fue imprudente que no se tomara la decisión con más antelación. El encuentro deportivo se suspendió cuando las lluvias eran torrenciales en València y ya se habían desplazado los aficionados al campo. "A mí me parece una imprudencia", ha manifestado el presidente de la Generalitat, antes de apuntar que le consta que "el Ayuntamiento de València recomendó que en una alerta naranja ese partido no se jugase". "Es cierto que no es una alerta roja y que si hay una alerta roja ese partido no se juega y que en una alerta naranja se puede jugar. Y es una decisión que toma LaLiga", ha explicado. Llorca ha indicado que durante el episodio de lluvias del miércoles "hubo momentos de tanta intensidad que parecía que nos acercábamos más a los parámetros de una alerta roja que de una alerta naranja". "Por lo tanto, hay que tomar precauciones", ha señalado. "El propio Ayuntamiento de València, el día antes, ya había avisado de que iba a suspender actividades por la tarde en la ciudad. A veces es un poco incomprensible que suspendamos o se suspendan por parte de los ayuntamientos actividades en la ciudad, como actividades escolares, y que en cambio se esté manteniendo un partido de fútbol. Ahí es donde creo que falta pedagogía y donde falta formación para todos a la hora de tomar decisiones", ha señalado el dirigente autonómico. Llorca ha apuntado que él no ha participado en "esa toma de decisión por parte de LaLiga" y que "sus motivos tendrán y ellos tendrán que explicarlo". "A mí, como ciudadano, sí que me ha parecido imprudente que ese partido se jugase. Y prueba de ello es que al final no llegó a jugarse, que se tuvo que suspender", ha zanjado.

articles.title: FA chief writes to Infantino demanding release of World Cup sell-off documents
articles.summary: Fifa president Gianni Infantino has been told to release all documents relating to his controversial plan to sell off a stake in the World Cup.
articles.body:
Fifa president Gianni Infantino has been told to release all documents relating to his controversial plan to sell off a stake in the World Cup in a letter sent by Football Association chair Debbie Hewitt.

Hewitt, a Fifa vice-president, said that the Fifa Council should also receive a written explanation for the cancelled suspension of United States forward Folarin Balogun at the World Cup.

Infantino should make all documents available before the next Fifa Council meeting, which is on 15 October.

The letter, also sent to Fifa secretary general Mattias Grafstrom, makes accusations of failures in governance and a breakdown in culture within the world football governing body.

Infantino has come under increasing pressure over his aborted Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal.

FFE would have meant a new company being created to manage commercial and ticketing rights of all competitions, including World Cups, with 21% sold off to a private investment company.

The proposal was scrapped following widespread opposition from national associations.

Hewitt's letter adds that there should be an independent review of how FFE was conceived, by whom, and how the private investment was put to tender.

Last month, Uefa began preparing criminal legal proceedings against Infantino at three US courts over the FFE plan, demanded the release of all documents.

Fifa hit back and accused Uefa of a "smear campaign against it and its leadership" in a challenge to the litigation .

Infantino, 56, will stand for election for a fourth time in March , with his opponents having until 18 November to find an alternative candidate.

Balogun incident placed doubts in FA's mind

The Football Association was troubled by the Balogun situation from the outset, and had requested the release of the documents relating to his overturned ban during the World Cup.

Forward Balogun, 25, was allowed to play against Belgium in the last 16 when he would have expected to be serving a one-match suspension.

The striker had been shown a straight red card for a foul on defender Tarik Muharemovic in the 2-0 win over Bosnia-Herzegovina in the last 32.

Fifa then said the automatic one-match ban would be suspended for a year. No reasoning behind the move was provided, beyond citing a rule which allows punishments to be suspended.

The FA, which had sent a letter of support for Infantino's re-election before the Balogun incident, had deep concerns about political intervention.

US President Donald Trump later confirmed he called Infantino asking for Balogun's ban to be reviewed.

Then the FFE proposal, revealed through the media just days after the World Cup final, fractured the game.

Fifa and Infantino were accused of breaking trust "through deception" in an open letter issued by Uefa, Concacaf and the Asian Football Confederation last month.

Many national associations, including those of England, Wales and Scotland, have withdrawn letters of support for Infantino's re-election.

But Infantino still holds a great deal of support around the globe, with the confederations of Africa, South America and Oceania reiterating their backing.

After FFE was cancelled, Infantino called a meeting of the Fifa management board in Rabat, Morocco.

But as yet there has been no contact with the Fifa Council to explain the controversial plan.

That is set to change next month when Infantino must face Hewitt and the other 35 Fifa Council members.

articles.title: Betis - Getafe en directo | Última hora de LALIGA EA Sports en vivo hoy
articles.summary: Isco se acerca a la hora de juego, veremos hasta cuando le estira Pelegrini. 57.000 aficionados en La Cartuja Juega sin prisas ahora el Betis, mueve l
articles.body:
Última hora del Betis - Getafe en directo:

E l Betis, que suma cuatro triunfos en las cinco primeras jornadas de Liga, recibe esta tarde en el Estadio de La Cartuja al Getafe con el objetivo de seguir con su gran momento de juego y resultados. Pero lo hará 'obligado' a rotar, con tres partidos en una misma semana, y también a cambiar de registro: enfrente no estarán equipos que dejan jugar como Real Madrid, Lille o Villarreal, a los que se enfrentó y consiguió ganar en la competición doméstica y en su estreno en la Champions League de la semana pasada en Francia, sino un adversario rocoso, que hace de la seguridad defensiva su punto fuerte y de los que obligan a trabajar el partido con calma... sin caer en la precipitación

Después de su victoria ante los de Mourinho y de estrenar su regreso a la Champions League con una brillante remontada en Francia, los de Pellegrini firmaron en La Cerámica el lunes su partido más completo en lo que va de curso, con hasta 26 remates. La máquina verdiblanca parece perfectamente engrasada y todo apunta a que esta tarde llegarán las rotaciones. Aunque por ahora no podrá contar con Diego Llorente ni con Ruibal, lesionados, el Ingeniero tiene a casi toda su plantilla disponible en busca de un triunfo que le permita seguir muy arriba en la clasificación. Ortiz, Junior, Valentín, Facundo, Antony y Parrott, apunta a estar entre las posibles novedades del once.

Alineaciones probables del Betis - Getafe MARCA

El Getafe visita un feudo como La Cartuja, llamado a ser uno de los más complejos y complicados de toda la categoría. El conjunto azulón quiere dar la sorpresa y, tras dos empates consecutivos en casa, llega a Sevilla con hambre de tres puntos. Bordalás recupera a Zaid Romero, que no estuvo contra el conjunto herculino, aunque seguirá contando, al menos, con las bajas de los jugadores lesionados que no estuvieron el pasado domingo. Además, el alicantino desveló en sala de prensa que tenía otros hombres aún tocados y que esperaría hasta hoy para ver si finalmente viajaban o no a la capital andaluza.

Duelo del partido Betis - Getafe | Valles vs. Soria

Álvaro Valles vs. David Soria : Son dos de los mejores guardametas de LaLiga. El de La Rinconada pasó un año en blanco en Las Palmas para cumplir su sueño de volver al Betis y se ha terminado convirtiendo en una pieza clave para Pellegrini, con intervenciones de mucho mérito. El madrileño, con pasado en el Sevilla, es el dueño indiscutible de la meta azulona desde hace casi una década y es clave en sus éxitos. Seis goles encajados y tres porterías a cero en cinco jornadas para el guardameta de los andaluces, y otros seis tantos en contra, pero sólo un partido sin encajar para el de los madrileños.

articles.title: Todd McShay's New 2027 NFL Mock Draft Drops with 4 QBs in 1st 5 Picks amid Manning, Moore Buzz
articles.summary: Two full weeks into the college football season and mock draft season is in full swing with Todd McShay releasing his latest look at the 2027 class.
articles.body:
Two full weeks into the college football season and mock draft season is in full swing with Todd McShay releasing his latest look at the 2027 class.

In McShay's new mock released for The Ringer, the top of the draft is dominated by quarterbacks with four coming off the board in the first five picks and six in the top 10, led by Arch Manning at No. 1 overall to the Miami Dolphins.

Here are the top 10 picks in McShay's initial 2027 projection.

McShay Not Concerned with Moore's Draft Stock

The Miami Dolphins are projected in the No. 1 spot right now. It seems like a safe bet based on how the front office went about constructing the roster in the offseason combined with an uninspired 27-13 loss to the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 1.

McShay did note he would expect "an absolute HAUL" of a trade offer for the top pick whomever ends up getting it.

The New York Jets were cited as the team most-likely to offer the haul since they could offer four first-round picks over the next two years, including three in 2027 thanks to previous trades with the Dallas Cowboys and Indianapolis Colts.

As for the player taken at the top of the draft, McShay cited Manning as having "NFL size, plenty of arm talent, and legitimate speed and play-extension mobility" as points in his favor.

The primary areas of concern for Manning, according to McShay, are his mechanics that tend to "come and go" and locking onto his primary reads for too long, but he has the "tools to be an elite NFL QB."

Even though Manning is in the No. 1 spot at the moment, Dante Moore has the same grade (95) as him in McShay's ranking.

Oregon has had a rough start to the season, but Moore is not to blame for the issues. He has thrown for 569 yards and five touchdowns with no interceptions on 66 attempts.

"He consistently throws receivers open and delivers a catchable ball that allows them to transition upfield immediately," McShay wrote about Moore.

No franchise has been begging for even competent quarterback play more than the Cleveland Browns. If they are able to land Moore in the draft, their ceiling looks much brighter with a group of skill-position talent already in place that includes Harold Fannin Jr., Denzel Boston and KC Concepcion.

Further down in the top 10, McShay suggests the Carolina Panthers might be ready to move on from Bryce Young by giving them CJ Carr with the seventh pick.

It wouldn't be a huge surprise if the Panthers made that call after opting not to extend Young in the offseason. Next year marks the final season of his rookie contract, so there is pressure on him to take a step forward after showing some progress in 2025.

The only non-quarterbacks among the top seven selections in McShay's projection are wide receivers Jeremiah Smith and Cam Coleman. He has them going to the Tennessee Titans and Las Vegas Raiders, respectively. Those are the two teams that have selected quarterbacks No. 1 overall in each of the past two years.

Smith to the Titans would essentially be recreating the top of the 2025 Ohio State receiver room after they selected Carnell Tate with the fourth pick in this year's draft.

It doesn't speak great of the Titans' roster-building process that they would be using back-to-back top-four picks on wide receivers, but Week 1 didn't make it seem like their offseason plan did a lot to help Cam Ward in his sophomore campaign.

The Raiders would seem to have wide receiver high on their list of priorities with Fernando Mendoza set to take over at some point either later this season or to start 2027.

Vegas' receiver depth chart right now is led by Tre Tucker, Jalen Nailor and Jack Bech. Tight end Brock Bowers gives the Raiders an elite passing-catching option, but they need more help on the outside as they build around Mendoza.

articles.title: La RFEF firma el acuerdo de celebración de la Supercopa en Estambul en febrero de 2027
articles.standfirst: El torneo cambia de sede y se jugará entre el 2 y 6 de febrero. Barcelona, Real Madrid, Real Sociedad y Atlético de Madrid serán los participantes
articles.summary: El torneo cambia de sede y se jugará entre el 2 y 6 de febrero. Barcelona, Real Madrid, Real Sociedad y Atlético de Madrid serán los participantes
articles.body: El presidente de la Real Federación Española de Fútbol (RFEF), Rafael Louzán, firmó este jueves en Estambul el acuerdo para la organización por primera vez en esta ciudad de la Supercopa del próximo año, programada del 2 al 6 de febrero, y en la que participarán Barcelona, Real Madrid, Real Sociedad y Atlético de Madrid. Serán tres los estadios, con una capacidad conjunta de unos 150.000 espectadores, donde se juegue la competición en la que tomarán parte los campeones de la Liga y la Copa del Rey y los respectivos subcampeones. La final tendrá como sede el estadio Ali Sami Yen, con un aforo de unos 52.000 personas y donde juega sus partidos el Galatasaray. La primera semifinal entre el Barcelona y el Atlético de Madrid, fijada el 2 de febrero, será en el estadio Chobani, feudo del Fenerbahce, con capacidad para unos 48.000 asientos. El otro finalista saldrá del duelo entre la Real Sociedad y el Real Madrid el día 3, que se disputará en el estadio Tupras, de 42.590 espectadores y donde juega de local el Besiktas. Según se anunció a mediados de agosto, Estambul toma el testigo de Arabia Saudí, donde se ha celebrado el torneo desde 2020, con la excepción de 2021, pero que no lo podrá acoger en la edición de 2027 al coincidir con la Copa Asia. Louzán se congratuló de que Estambul releve a Arabia Saudí para albergar el primer título de la temporada. "Hoy presentamos mucho más que un acuerdo para organizar una competición, sino la relación de dos países que viven el fútbol con una pasión extraordinaria y que comparte esta forma intensa de sentir el deporte, de llenar los estadios y de defender unos colores", ensalzó el presidente de la RFEF. En su intervención en el acto, celebrado en la sede de la Federación Turca de Fútbol, Louzán confió en que no sea la única ocasión en que el país otomano sea la sede de la Supercopa y en que "sea el comienzo de una relación mas fuerte" entre el fútbol español y el turco. "Porque el fútbol tiene esa virtud y responsabilidad: une países y acerca culturas", afirmó Louzán, quien resaltó "el momento extraordinario" que atraviesan las relaciones entre ambos países en numerosos ámbitos. Se mostró convencido de que Estambul "se volcará" con el torneo y la afición turca "lo hará como suyo". En la edición del pasado año, la RFEF se embolsó 51 millones de euros por el acuerdo con Arabia Saudí, dinero que se reparte entre los cuatro participantes y las categorías inferiores del fútbol español.

articles.summary: Además, el delantero del Burgos también tendrá que pagar la multa que le ponga el club
articles.body: Cuatro meses de multa a 10 euros al día (en total 1.200 euros) y la retirada del carnet de conducir durante 244 días (unos 8 meses) es la pena que tiene que cumplir Jon Karrikaburu al aceptar ayer la sentencia en el Juzgado de Instrucción número 1 de Iruñea tras un juicio rápido en Pamplona. Dicha condena es debido a un delito contra la seguridad vial, ya que el delantero del Burgos arrojó una tasa de 0,73 miligramos de alcohol por litro de aire espirado, una tasa por encima del umbral penal que es de 0,60 miligramos. Por otro lado, el Burgos ha indicado que su jugador Karrikaburu deberá afrontar una multa interna por incumplir el régimen disciplinario de la entidad de El Plantío. Los hechos tuvieron lugar sobre las 18.15 horas del pasado domingo 13 de septiembre en la N 121-A, en la localidad de Etulain, justo en el día libre que el técnico Sergio Francisco dio a su plantilla. Eso sí, nada más producirse, Karrikaburu se puso en contacto con los dirigentes de la entidad burgalesa, así como con Michu, el director deportivo. El delantero los llamó para contarle lo sucedido y trasladar sus disculpas y arrepentimiento. El jugador se incorporará al trabajo del grupo con todos sus compañeros.

articles.title: Jonathan David: una hazaña de 30 años... y una amenaza al Madrid
articles.standfirst: Desde Esnaider en el 96 ningún jugador del Atlético marcaba en sus dos primeros partidos de Liga. El domingo recibe a un Madrid al que ya tumbó con el Lille
articles.summary: Desde Esmaider en el 96 ningún jugador del Atlético marcaba en sus dos primeros partidos de Liga. El domingo recibe a un Madrid al que ya tumbó con el Lille
articles.body: “¿Qué tengo que hacer para quedarme? Marcar goles”, deslizaba Jonathan David en las entrañas del Metropolitano el día de su presentación. Acababa de firmar una cesión procedente de la Juventus, donde las cosas no le salieron bien, con una opción de compra de 25 millones de euros. El objetivo, convencer a los rojiblancos para abonar la cantidad y ser del Atleti más allá de este préstamo hasta el 30 de junio de 2027. Y David está cumpliendo su reto. Salió en Anoeta y marcó el gol de la tranquilidad. Se estrenó de inicio en el Metropolitano y abrió la lata ante Osasuna (además de una asistencia a Kang-in). Incidencia ofensiva de nivel en dos ratos para lograr una hazaña de otro siglo: celebrar goles en sus dos primeros partidos de LaLiga. Hace exactamente 30 años que un delantero del Atlético no lo hacía en sus dos primeros choques de LaLiga. El último (lo habían hecho 11 en total antes: Fernández, Pruden, Miranda, Estruch, Mendonça, Vava, Urtiaga, Aguilar, Rodax, Esnaider y Penev) fue Juan Eduardo Esnaider y desde entonces ninguno de los primeros espadas que ocuparon el ataque rojiblanco lo ha logrado. Y la nómina es interminable: Falcao, Costa, Griezmann, Kun, Forlán… palabras mayores. De momento, lo ha logrado sin competencia en la delantera. Sorloth está en la recta final de su recuperación para estrenarse este curso, mientras Julián fue baja los dos últimos partidos por molestias musculares. Cuando estén sanos, el canadiense tendrá dos puntas de nivel con los que tendrá que competir por un sitio en el once. Sea como fuere, su altísimo promedio goleador es el mejor aval del ex de la Juve y de un Lille donde se ganó un sitio en la élite superando los 20 goles por temporada. Esa cifra que siempre supone una barrera para Simeone cuando hablamos de delanteros. Precisamente en el Lille fue donde se midió con éxito a su próximo rival, el Madrid. Fue en la Champions 24-25 David marcó desde el punto fatídico el tanto que sirvió para tumbar a los madridistas. Un gol que sirve de recuerdo de lo que puede aportar un punta que ese mismo curso tomó el Metropolitano con un doblete. La del domingo será la tercera vez que se mida al Madrid ya que el año pasado lo hizo con la Juve. Apenas, eso sí, jugó 15 minutos en el choque del Bernabéu. Con sus números parece que el 15 tendrá más opciones de ser de la partida como amenaza de los de Mou… y justo tres décadas después de una hazaña que nadie lograba con la rojiblanca. En el derbi, David intentará unirse al listado de jugadores que marcaron en sus tres primeros partidos en el Atlético enLaLiga. Así, se uniría a Fernández (lo logró en la temporada 41-42), Pruden (en la 40-41, incluyendo un hat-trick ante el Madrid y cuatro en la visita alAthletic), Mendonça, Aguilar y LuboPenev. El búlgaro es, así las cosas, el último de este listado que ha elevado a tres los choques seguidos marcando en su estreno como jugadores del Atlético. Ese es el objetivo de unJonathan que, a este ritmo, convencerá a la Dirección deportiva del Atlético de abonar esos 25 millones de euros. Ya saben, “los goles” son los que marcarán la apuesta definitiva por el delantero canadiense.
